THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES03 / 18
03
THE RIGHT LOGO, ON THE RIGHT SURFACE

Two color versions.
Logo in PNG and SVG.

The logo is our official brand mark. Choose the yellow logo for Brand Green #39823C and the green logo for Brand Gold #F3CB2D. Each color is available as transparent SVG and transparent PNG masters. The named wordmark logo is not permitted.

Yellow logo · transparentONLY ON BRAND GREEN · #39823C
PNGSVG
Green logo · transparentONLY ON BRAND GOLD · #F3CB2D
PNGSVG
KEEP THE IDENTITY INTACT

Logo only.
Clear boundaries.

The logo is the sole visual brand mark. The named wordmark logo is not permitted in brand communications.

  • Use only the official logo; do not use the named logo.
  • Yellow logo belongs ONLY on Brand Green #39823C.
  • Green logo belongs ONLY on Brand Gold #F3CB2D.
  • No transparent logos on white, cream, black or arbitrary colors.
  • No transparent logos directly over photography or gradients.
  • No stretching, rotation, or added text lockups.

01

Logo only

Use the official logo exclusively across all brand surfaces. Do not use any named or wordmark logo lockups.

02

Yellow logo on Brand Green

Place the yellow logo only on the solid Brand Green surface #39823C. Do not place it on gold, white, cream, black, photography, gradients or arbitrary colors.

03

Green logo on Brand Gold

Place the green logo only on the solid Brand Gold surface #F3CB2D. Do not place it on green, white, cream, black, photography, gradients or arbitrary colors.

04

Artwork colors

Brand Green #39823C is our primary brand surface. The logo artwork uses the authentic yellow and green palette. Always maintain high contrast and pure brand backgrounds.

05

Transparent masters

Both SVG and 2160 × 2160 PNG formats are available for both colorways. Transparent means the background is removed to sit cleanly on solid Brand Green or Brand Gold surfaces.

06

No named logo or wordmark

Do not include or reconstruct named logos or typography with the symbol. The standalone logo represents the brand.

07

Never alter the mark

Do not stretch, rotate, crop, add outlines, recolor, add drop shadows or modify the logo artwork.
